Priya R.: Heads-up: p99 across EU/US jumped ~120ms after yesterday's routing tweak that enabled cross-zone fallback. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 (quick look shows a distinct tail). @Miguel L., @Kai T. any initial thoughts?
Miguel L.: I saw that too. Spike correlates with fallback to a US-hosted model variant when eu-west capacity hit a threshold. p95 unchanged. My hunch: KV-cache miss amplification + smaller microbatches due to higher RTT.
Kai T.: Quick query to reproduce aggregated metrics: ```curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=p99,requests&from=1719420000&to=1719460000&filter=eu" | jq .``` ran it and see clear step at 02:08 UTC.
Eli (perf): Profiler snapshot from a sample window shows kernel selection falling back to generic matmul path on cross-zone executions: kernel chosen `matmul_generic` vs expected `matmul_optimized_fp16`. Flame shows larger CPU stalls during KV miss handling.
Anya: Could microbatching window be expiring earlier because of increased RTT on cross-zone requests? If the batch window sees fewer arrivals it will flush smaller microbatches, raising per-token overhead. :thinking:
Sara: Routing logs indicate fallback count increased ~3x between 02:00-03:20 UTC. KV-cache hit-rate for EU requests dropped from 92% -> 65% in that window. Also seeing more small batches (mode=1 or 2).
Miguel L.: Proposed mitigations: 1) prefer local kernel variant selection even if model variant differs slightly, 2) bump `batch.max_wait_ms` for cross-zone routes (current 12ms -> try 20ms), 3) add conservative kernel-hint when we detect compiled kernels. Tradeoffs: bump increases p95 slightly but can tighten p99 tail.
Priya R.: Plan: run a controlled experiment for 2h routing 25% cross-zone traffic with `batch.max_wait_ms=25` and pin kernel hint `prefer_optimized=True` for the pinned flavor. Measure p95/p99, microbatch size histograms, and cost delta. I'll open a feature-flagged rollout.
infra-bot: deploy: rollout start: routing-experiment-1719454321 -> 10% traffic. CI checks passed.
Kai T.: Note: kernel hint only helps when variant has precompiled kernels. If fallback goes to a quantized/compatible-but-uncompiled variant, hint will be ignored and we still see generic path. Need to gate hint on `compiled_kernels==true`.
Eli (perf): I'll add a tracing span to capture `batch.size` histogram and `kernel.selected` per request: `runtime.trace("batch_hist")` and include `kernel_hint` tag. Collect for 4h post-rollout.
Priya R.: Good. If tail improves but p95 regresses, we may need an adaptive policy: increase wait for cross-zone when fallback probability > X. Can someone sketch the heuristic?
Miguel L.: Draft heuristic: if `routing.prob_fallback(zone) > 0.1` AND `kv.hit_rate(zone) < 0.8` then `batch.wait_ms = min(40, base_wait_ms * 1.5)` else `batch.wait_ms = base_wait_ms`. Also prefer `prefer_optimized` only when `compiled_kernels==true`.
Anya: Ack. Also add rollback guard: auto-rollback feature flag if p99 increases > 15% vs baseline or cost increases > 20% for the experiment window.
Priya R.: Thanks all — collect traces and we'll reconvene in 3h with perf dashboard + sample traces. If anyone sees immediate regressions, @infra-bot please pause the rollout. :thumbsup:
